non_lab_people.name: BU CTSI (general contact)
non_lab_people.title: Clinical & Translational Science Institute
non_lab_people.why: Research-support service/infrastructure organization, not a PI-led lab. Provides shared resources (biostatistics/BERD program, pilot grants, core lab support, regulatory support, research navigator team) across BU/BMC, and hosts 'BU Profiles', an open-source research-networking/expertise-search tool (a customized Harvard Catalyst Profiles instance) rather than its own roster of labs.

notes: The targets.csv people_url (the 'BU Profiles' page) is CTSI's description of its research-networking search tool, not a static faculty roster -- it links out to an open-ended search interface (profiles.bu.edu/search/) covering all of BU/BMC, not CTSI-specific researchers. No CTSI-specific PI-led labs found; recorded as a support organization only. Funded under NIH grant UM1TR005308.
